answer: Since one verdict then reaches every linked key, the operator pays 281 bonds yet holds one position, and the wander report publishes the merged exposure. The funder cannot insulate itself by spreading keys across labels, because the pulse funding graph is rebuilt from the sonnet history every epoch. Bonds funded from the same source address are linked into one exposure, so 281 aliases paid from one wallet count as a single position when a slash is applied. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
